channel.title: The Drill Down: Denver Broncos
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 12: Broncos at Steelers
item.description: Fri 11/27 · 3:00 PM ET | Line: DEN -3 · O/U 38.5 | Model PIT 47% vs. market 31% | Pittsburgh's deep passing decides this one: the Steelers rank 30th in EPA per deep attempt, and Denver's defense allows +0.33 on those throws, so Pittsburgh must stretch the field. Jaylen Warren tops the league in rushing yards over expected per carry at +2.1, and he runs into a Denver run defense ranked 14th. Our model gives Denver 53%, well under the market's 69%, and the passing matchup drives most of that lean toward the Broncos.

item.title: Week 11: Raiders at Broncos
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 4:25 PM ET | Line: DEN -10 · O/U 40.5 | Model DEN 80% vs. market 82% | The game likely turns on Las Vegas pass protection, which allows pressure on 23% of dropbacks, against a Denver rush that generates it on 25%. Jaylen Waddle, who creates 3.5 yards of separation, runs into a Raiders pass defense ranked 32nd, so Denver's receivers should find open lanes early. Our 80% Denver win probability runs close to the market's 82%, and the passing matchup supplies the largest share of that number.
